source.name: SportsPro: 'Aston Villa sign UK£20m-a-year Visit Rwanda shirt sponsorship despite sportswashing concerns' (citing The Athletic)
source.note: Club-wide figure: up to £20m a year if bonuses are met, across men's, women's and academy shirts; the women's share is not stated. The same page says Amnesty International 'says Rwanda is using new deal for sportswashing purposes'.
source.quote: Visit Rwanda’s branding will appear on the front of all men’s, women’s, and academy teams’ shirts as part of the deal

note: Replaces Betano as the club's principal partner. Amnesty International warned the deal is sportswashing. The reported value (up to GBP 20m a year) is for the club-wide deal, recorded on villa-visit-rwanda; it covers the men's, women's and academy shirts, so it is not repeated here.
